an6.50:1.1: indriyasaṃvare bhikkhave asati indriyasaṃvaravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti sīlaṃ
an6.50:1.2: sīle asati sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi
an6.50:1.3: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an6.50:1.4: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an6.50:1.5: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an6.50:1.7: tassa pappaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati tacopi na pāripūriṃ gacchati pheggupi na pāripūriṃ gacchati sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati
an6.50:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave indriyasaṃvare asati indriyasaṃvaravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti sīlaṃ …pe…
an6.50:2.1: indriyasaṃvare bhikkhave sati indriyasaṃvarasampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti sīlaṃ
an6.50:2.2: sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
an6.50:2.3: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an6.50:2.4: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an6.50:2.5: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an6.50:2.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno tassa pappaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati tacopi pāripūriṃ gacchati pheggupi pāripūriṃ gacchati sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati
an6.50:2.7: evameva kho bhikkhave indriyasaṃvare sati indriyasaṃvarasampannassa …pe… upanissayasampannaṃ hoti
